dict.string: MuH lets terminal sessions and the apps they launch send automation events to other apps.
MuH lets terminal sessions and the apps they launch capture system audio.
MuH lets terminal sessions and the apps they launch use the camera.
MuH needs access so terminal sessions can read and write files on your Desktop.
MuH needs access so terminal sessions can read and write files in your Documents folder.
MuH needs access so terminal sessions can read and write files in your Downloads folder.
MuH lets terminal sessions and the apps they launch use the microphone.
MuH needs access so terminal sessions can read and write files on mounted network volumes.
MuH needs access so terminal sessions can read and write files on removable volumes.
